xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: In FY 2015-16, Revenue Expenditure incurred by the Company but held to be capital in nature by the Assessing Officer (AO) in the assessment orders passed raising a demand of Rs. 23.32 Crs. The issue was decided in favour of the Company by Hon’ble Allahabad High Court in earlier years but Income Tax Department has raised tax demand on same issue in subsequent years and same are pending before CIT(Appeals).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company expects to get relief from the Appellate Authority and does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received final assessment order dated September 27, 2024 and date of receipt of order is September 30, 2024 for FY 2016-17 raising tax demand of Rs. 70.79 crores on account of certain Transfer Pricing Adjustments.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company expects to get relief from the Appellate Authority and does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received final assessment order dated October 23, 2024 and date of receipt of order is October 23, 2024 for FY 2020-21, raising tax demand of Rs. 215.97 crores primarily arising on account of mistakes apparent from records apart from certain Transfer Pricing Adjustments and other corporate adjustment. Further, a rectification application is submitted to the Jurisdictional Assessing Officer and pending disposal. The Company expects to get relief from the Assessing Officer.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Update. The Company has received the rectification order whereby the tax demand has been reduced from Rs. 215.97 Crores (original demand - Rs. 216.19 crores) to Rs. 190.21 Crores. The Company continues to believe that the impugned tax demand raised vide aforementioned rectification order has been made ignoring contentions of the Company. The Company has already filed an appeal in the said matter. Post such redressal process, impugned tax demand so raised is likely to get deleted. The Company does not anticipate any material financial implications
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: For FY 2017-18, Appeal Pending before ITAT against Transfer Pricing adjustment raising a demand of Rs. 17 Crs in relation to alleged international transactions in violation of judicial precedents.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No Change The Appellate Authority has remanded the matter back to Assessing Officer to pass the fresh order as per the directions of Dispute Resolution Panel.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has filed Writ Petition before the Hon’ble Delhi High Court against the impugned order passed by National Anti-Profiteering Authority for not passing the benefit of GST to consumers. Hon’ble Delhi High Court has granted interim-stay in the matter. The Company has deposited Rs 20 crores in terms of the directions issued by Hon’ble Delhi High Court.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company expects to get relief from the Hon'ble Delhi Court and does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has filed appeal before Appellate Authority against the order of Joint Commissioner/Ld. Additional Commissioner for disallowing input tax credit (ITC) for FY 2017-18 raising a demand of Rs.15.18 Crs. 1st Appellate Authority passed the order and reduced partial demand and balance amount confirmed. The Company has made Pre-Deposit of Rs 3.06 crores against such impugned demand. Appeal to be filed before Tribunal.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company expects to get relief from the Appellate Authority and does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has filed appeal before Appellate Authority against the order of Joint Commissioner/Ld. Additional Commissioner for disallowing input tax credit (ITC) for FY 2018-19 raising a demand of Rs. 56.26 Crs. 1st Appellate Authority passed the order and reduced partial demand and balance amount confirmed. The Company has made Pre-Deposit of Rs 11.32 crores against such impugned demand. Appeal to be filed before Tribunal.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company expects to get relief from the Appellate Authority and does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received Show cause notice amounting to Rs. 47.5 Crs in relation to different years issued by Ld. Additional Director, DGGI to show cause why GST be not charged at higher rate of 18% on delivery charges. The Company has submitted its reply before the relevant authority in support of charging GST @5%.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received an Order levying demand of INR 17.12 Crs (including interest – INR 7.68 Crs & Penalty - INR 0.91 Cr) on account of reconciliation issues in GST Input Tax Credit claimed/reversed and GST Output Turnover & Tax Liability in the state of Karnataka. The matter is pending before 1st Appellate Authority.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Update. During the quarter, Karnataka Goods & Service Tax Appellate Authority, has issued an order, resulting in a reduction of tax exposure to Rs. 2.70 lakhs and the same has been paid. Case is closed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received an Order under Section 74 of CGST Act, 2017 read with section 20 of IGST & MGST Act, 2017 wherein the eligible GST credit amounting to INR 14,56,77,211/- with interest applicable has been disallowed and Penalty – INR 14,56,77,211/- has been imposed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: No change. The Company has filed the appeal against the order and expects to get relief from the Appellate Authority and does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received an Order under Section 74 of CGST Act, 2017 read with section 20 of IGST & PGST Act, 2017 whereby the demand of GST of INR 81,16,178/; Penalty of INR 81,16,178/- and applicable interest has been imposed alleging the excess eligible ITC availed under the Input Service Distribution (ISD) mechanism.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company believes that the order passed is incorrect and has not considered the merits of the contentions of the Company. The Company is in process of filing an appeal in the said matter. Post such redressal process, impugned demand so raised is likely to be dropped. The Company does not anticipate any material adverse financial implication
